title: docs(adr): ADR-0139 / ADR-0055 record the view-all unrestricted-reader chain drop (#33696 ruling)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96MB8994zPjb9j9J5mcDtv1)_

Fixes #33820

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6893666857

Records the maintainer's re-ruling on #33696, option 「只对管理员去掉」 (record [6893666857](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/33696#issuecomment-6893666857), 2026-11-15T11:31Z, replacing 6893097935), in ADR-0139 and ADR-0055. This is the governed precondition the ruling names: #33696's code (draft PR #33897) must not land before this PR merges.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在 ADR-0139 和 ADR-0055 各加 2026-11-15 的修订说明,记录裁决 6893666857(「只对管理员去掉」):只有「在子对象上有查看全部权限、每一级主对象读范围都不受限、主对象外键必填」的读者去掉父链,能看到本租户内主记录为空或指向不存在主记录的子记录;其他读者(包括普通成员)不变。
- 为什么改:这条裁决只对这一类读者放开了 ADR-0139 D6 里已记录的一条禁令(#24932 裁决 B 第 4 条),按规则推翻已接受 ADR 的决定要先改 ADR;裁决原文要求本修订先合并,#33696 的代码后合并。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档、只增不改(+43 / −0),不改变任何运行时行为;回滚即 revert 本 PR,回滚后 #33696 的代码不能合并。
- 先看:① ADR-0139 D6 末尾新增段(三条逐字引用的裁决条款,以及放开哪一条、哪一条不动);② ADR-0055「The rules the read keeps」下的新增说明(必填主对象上无主记录行的读者规则);③ ADR-0139 Status 段末尾的新增条目。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD`,预期只有两行 `6 0 docs/adr/0055-…` 与 `37 0 docs/adr/0139-…`,删除数都是 0。
- 需要你做的:批准并合并本 PR(#33696 的代码等它合并)

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md` (+37 / −0), two insertions:
  - A dated `**Amended** (2026-11-15)` entry at the end of the Status paragraph. D6's ⛔ on "interim removal of the predicate for an unrestricted master scope" (#24932 ruling B item 4) is lifted for one reader class and nothing else: a reader who holds view-all on the detail AND whose every master hop answers unrestricted (the engine's per-hop scope, not `hasSuperuserReadBypass`), with a required master FK. D6's other ⛔ item (an interim with two spellings of one scope) stands.
  - A dated paragraph at the end of D6 carrying the record's three binding bullets verbatim (reader class; the lift and the landing order; multi-tenant), naming the near-miss readers who keep the predicate, and saying why ADR-0055 moves now despite D6's "ADR-0055's own text moves only in that switch's edit, never here": the ruling's own order, quoted — "citing this record; ADR-0055's 10-22 note in step".
- `docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md` (+6 / −0), four insertions:
  - A new `· **Amended** (2026-11-15, #33696, ruling 「只对管理员去掉」 6893666857)` status entry.
  - A `⚠️ **Amended 2026-11-15 …**` mark directly under the 2026-10-22 status entry (the "10-22 note in step").
  - A `⚠️` note in §2, under the 2026-11-06 (#30905 ruling A) note.
  - A `⚠️` note under "The rules the read keeps" in the 2026-11-06 amendment, so the rows-with-no-master rule reads as one statement: optional master, the owner and View All on the detail (unchanged); required master, only View All on the detail with every master hop unrestricted; members keep the chain.

## Why

Prime Directive 13: reversing a recorded decision needs an amended status line on the ADR that records it. The ruling lifts ADR-0139 D6's ⛔ for one reader class and orders this amendment to merge before #33696's code.

## Acceptance notes

- **In place as well as on the status line (seat hypothesis, measured):** both files, each following its own precedent. ADR-0139 follows its 2026-10-21 amendment (status entry plus a dated `**Amended … verbatim:**` D6 paragraph with a blockquote). ADR-0055 follows its 2026-10-22 amendment, the one the ruling names (status entry plus in-place `⚠️ **Amended …**` notes, no end-of-file section); the mark under a status entry follows the 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-06 entries' trailing marks.
- **Append-only:** `git diff --numstat` reads `37 0` and `6 0`; no existing line changed or re-wrapped. So the ADR-0139 entry sits at the end of the Status paragraph, and the ADR-0055 mark for the 2026-10-22 entry is its own line directly under it (renders as that entry's continuation).
- **Decision letters, base → head:** ADR-0139 `D` headings 6 → 6, bold leads 0 → 0, table rows 0 → 0; ADR-0055 0/0/0 → 0/0/0. No new `path#Symbol` anchor; `docs/adr/README.md` unchanged (`check:adr-index` current).
- **#33897 is not described as landed:** both records say the change "lands only after" this amendment and name no symbol or mechanism of it.
- **Quoted verbatim:** the reader-class, lift-and-ordering and multi-tenant bullets. Not restated: the record's pins and release-note bullets and the orphan-sources follow-up card, which belong to #33696.
- **Derived, not verbatim (seat to check):** "on a required master the owner has no arm"; the two near-miss readers in D6 (unrestricted hops without view-all on the detail; view-all on the detail with a restricted hop), which follow from the first bullet's AND and coincide with the record's pins bullet; "a master scope that is the tenant wall is not unrestricted" (the multi-tenant bullet); and ADR-0055's "§3 (the write gate) is not amended by this note", true of the note and consistent with claim amendment 6895345175 on #33696, but not a ruling sentence.
- **Round 2 (contract review 6896995006, PASS on dca1f17e):** S1 taken: the ADR-0055 §2 note now restates the full reader class, adding "(the engine's per-hop scope, not `hasSuperuserReadBypass`)" and "inside its own tenant wall". N2 taken: the mark under the 2026-10-22 status entry now says the parent chain over a required master "is dropped for one reader class" instead of describing the unlanded code's query shape. N1 and N3 unchanged. The three open questions are answered A in that record (the §3 clause stays; no view-all bit definition; no further marks). One new commit, 0e1c1bca, touching only the two ADR-0055 lines this PR added; numstat is still `37 0` and `6 0`.
- **Authoring tier:** this card's tier is mandatory CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (`docs/adr/**`). The card thread runs a lower tier, so the ADR text was authored by an isolated `os-dev` subagent pinned to model alias `fable` in the card worktree on this branch (effort xhigh); round 2 went through the same route. The thread reviewed round 1 and changed one wording (which D6 item is lifted: "the second of the two things above that the ruling ⛔ does not take", since D6 carries one ⛔ over two items).

## Verification

Head `0e1c1bca` (round 2; round 1 at `dca1f17e` read the same 21/21), `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 21 commands for the two paths; all 21 run locally after the last commit, each `exit 0`:

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
